notes: Seven web searches ran; none were refused. She has held no elected office, so there is no official site; I checked her campaign site eileenforcolorado.com directly: the platform page (https://www.eileenforcolorado.com/platform) mentions 'technology' only for first responders and says nothing about AI; the about page and press releases page (latest 14 November 2026) also have no mention of AI. The /news page returned 404 and the /media page's list of articles could not be read (truncated), so media coverage linked there was not checked. A KRDO candidate Q&A (17 June 2026, https://krdo.com/?p=1734084) does not mention AI. As a non-member she could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act and did not sign the House letters. Search coverage of a first-time candidate is thin; debate transcripts and candidate questionnaires (for example iVoterGuide) were not read in full.
